EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}We rodents get a pretty bad rap for
being "disease-ridden little balls of
gnarly hate."{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0007:}}I hate it!
{{TAG:0003:0008:}}I'm not a bad guy!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I wash regularly,
get my shots, pay my loans, even
say hello in a friendly way!
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Oh well.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}At least people are talking
about me.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Better than not talking
about me at all,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} so happy new year!
ES:
¡{{TAG:0004:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} es el año de la rata,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}! Somos casi primos
hermanos.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tendré que estar presentable
para no dejar en mal lugar a la
familia.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Je, je, je!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En {{TAG:0004:0000:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} les gens nés au cours de
l'année du rat seront sous le feu des
projecteurs,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}C'est-à-dire que la tendance
grignoteuse des rongeurs sera
encore accentuée.
Du coup, m'en veux pas si je
m'attaque au poteau de ta boîte
aux lettres un jour, {{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}hé hé !

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Nel {{TAG:0004:0000:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} i nati sotto il segno
del Topo saranno al centro
dell'attenzione!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}E questo vale anche{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} per tutti i topi
e gli altri roditori, como yo. Dovrò
essere ancora più raffinato!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ah ah!
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Ma attenzione! Il calendario lunare,
su cui si basa lo zodiaco cinese...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}... non corrisponde a quello solare
che usiamo noi. {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Se non lo sapevi,
ora hai imparato qualcosa de nuevo!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:0004:0000:}} ist das Jahr der Ratte,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Das heißt, wir Nagetiere bekommen
dieses Jahr mehr Aufmerksamkeit.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ich sollte mich schick anziehen!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The calendar shifts to a new year,
but I'm not content to just sit
around and wait for the next one.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Nope!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} This year,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}I'm finally going to
figure out how to speed time along!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Then we get right back to holidays!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Shouldn't be too difficult, really.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
I mean,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0021:}}I'm a strong guy,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} and time
seems pretty flimsy.
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}One good punch should solve that
whole "space-time continuum"
problem right up!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Then once we bovines control time,
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}maybe someone ELSE will have to
handle the milk supply!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}So{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} that's just a little snippet from
my graphic novel.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}It's still in the
rough stages.
ES:
¡Este es el año del buey!
Los bueyes han estado esperando
doce años para ganar protagonismo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Es una lástima que después del día
de Año Nuevo nadie les vaya a hacer
ni caso,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}En {{TAG:0004:0000:}}, nous entrerons dans
l'année du buffle !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Après 12 longues années de
traversée du désert, les buffles
reviennent à la mode{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Était-ce vraiment nécessaire...?

Quindi, anche noi tori saremo
sotto i riflettori{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}

Diese Jahr ist das Jahr des Büffels.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Nach zwölf langen Jahren stehen wir
Rinder also wieder im Rampenlicht!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Wobei die Leute das morgen
wahrscheinlich schon wieder
vergessen haben, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Tigers are awesome.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I don't even
want to argue this fact with you,
because I don't feel the need.
Plus,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:001C:}}we tigers have a bad habit of
losing our cool when backed in a
corner, and you don't want that.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I once had a guy come to my door
trying to sell me some magazine
subscriptions.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I kept saying no, but he just wasn't
listening,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} just repeating, {{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:000D:0004:04CD}}"no, really,

{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Well, I was having none of that,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0007:}}so I

the door right in his face.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I felt bad afterward,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} so I bought
37 subscriptions,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but, man,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}I really
hated my outburst of insanity.
IT:
È arrivato finalmente, dopo
12 anni di attesa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
l'anno della Tigre!
Non che cambi molto per me{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}

Nach zwölf Jahren ist es endlich
wieder so weit...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dieses Jahr ist
das Jahr des Tigers!
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Und jetzt rate mal, wer von uns
beiden der Tiger ist!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}WAS? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Es kann gar nicht sein, dass
ich ein Tiger bin?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Du machst wohl Witze!
TRANSLATION:

Üstelik{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:001C:}}biz kaplanlar köşeye sıkışınca

bunu istemezsin.

inevitably sent me another huge
batch of carrots.
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}They just keep watching the news
every night and get fed the same
old carrot agenda, which is sad.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Rabbits need more than carrots!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Everyone assumes otherwise, but
it's the truth!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Oh well.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Food's food.

de la liebre.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} ¡Este será nuestro
momento,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

i miei sogni!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ah ah ah!

bu!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Neyse.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Yemek yemektir.

dance until I pass out{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}but that's

FR:

l'année du coq. Autant dire que
tout ce qui a des ailes est en fête !
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Hé, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} tu m'as déjà vu

majestueux ?

crois-moi, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:0004:0000:}} ist das Jahr des Hahnes...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
In diesem Jahr stehen wir Vögel
ganz besonders im Rampenlicht!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Zeit, das alte Gefieder abzuwerfen
und zu spektakulären Höhenflügen
anzusetzen!

aklına gelecek yüz bu olacak!

I have an insatiable urge to {{TAG:0003:002A:}}wag my
tail like it's nobody's business!

right around the corner, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

{{TAG:0004:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} {{TAG:0003:000F:}}Hé ?! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Mais alors c'est

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:0004:0000:}} ist das Jahr des Hundes...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
